verses.text: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but whoever hates being corrected is stupid.
The LORD is pleased with a good person, but he condemns someone who plans evil.
No one can be made secure by doing evil, but the roots of good people cannot be pulled up.
A good wife is like a crown to her husband, but a wife who brings shame is like a disease in his bones.
The plans of good people are fair, but the advice of the wicked is full of lies.
The words of the wicked are a trap to kill people, but the words of honest people rescue them.
The wicked are destroyed and gone, but the family of good people stands firm.
People are praised for their wisdom, but those with twisted minds are looked down on.
It is better to be unimportant and have a servant than to act important and have no food.
Good people take care of their animals, but even the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.
Whoever works their land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases dreams has no sense.
The wicked want what evil people have stolen, but the roots of good people produce fruit.
Evil people are trapped by their sinful words, but good people escape from trouble.
People are filled with good things by what they say, and the work of their hands brings them a reward.
Fools think their own way is right, but wise people listen to advice.
Fools show their anger right away, but sensible people ignore an insult.
An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.
Careless words cut like a sword, but the words of wise people bring healing.
Truthful words last forever, but lies last only a moment.
There are lies in the hearts of those who plan evil, but those who work for peace are full of joy.
No real harm comes to good people, but the wicked are full of trouble.
The LORD hates lying lips, but he is pleased with people who are truthful.
Sensible people keep their knowledge to themselves, but fools announce their foolishness.
Hard-working people will rule, but lazy people will end up as slaves.
Worry weighs a person down, but a kind word cheers them up.
Good people are careful about choosing friends, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
Lazy people do not even cook what they have hunted, but hard-working people value what they have.
The path of goodness leads to life. On that path there is no death.
